subject: CloudMart marketplace activation — procurement checklist & PO path
messages:
From: Jessica Park <jessica.park@cloudmart.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cloudmart.com
Date: 2026-01-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Inquiry: vendor activation + PO workflow for Redwood listing

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — CloudMart is excited about listing Redwood Inference in our marketplace. Procurement has asked me to get the vendor intake packet and PO path documented before we spin up the listing. Can you share the steps your finance team needs, plus any standard PO template we should use?

Key asks from our side:
- A single point of contact for vendor onboarding and billing escalation
- Redwood's preferred invoicing cadence and payment terms (net30/net45)
- Any required tax forms (W-9 / W-8BEN) or legal attachments for US vendors
- Whether you'll accept purchase orders tied to an AWS Marketplace SaaS contract, or if CloudMart needs to issue direct vendor invoices

We also need a short list of required attachments (certificate of insurance, SOC 2 report, company W-9) so our legal ops can clear the vendor quickly. I've attached our internal vendor intake checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Jessica Park
Vendor Programs — CloudMart
procurement@cloudmart.com
Attachments: cloudmart_vendor_intake_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica.park@cloudmart.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-08T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: vendor activation + PO workflow for Redwood listing

Hi Jessica — great to connect. Thanks for the checklist. Looping in Vanessa (Marketplace Partnerships) and Ben (FinOps) so we can cover the billing path and PO specifics.

Short answers up front:
- Point of contact: Mina Haddad (vendor onboarding) — mina_haddad@redwood.com; billing escalation: Ben Carter — ben_carter@redwood.com
- Payment terms we typically accept: net30 standard; net45 possible for enterprise accounts (requires approval)
- Required tax/legal docs: W-9 for US entities, SOC 2 Type II summary, Certificate of Insurance (general liability)
- AWS Marketplace: we can accept PO's tied to an AWS SaaS contract, but bookkeeping differs (AWS invoices to reseller). If CloudMart wants AWS-billed marketplace purchases to flow through the AWS invoicing path, we need the Marketplace listing ID and reseller details.

I've attached our vendor onboarding packet (fillable) and a PO template the finance team prefers. Please complete the vendor packet fields and return with your signed PO. Once we receive the signed PO + onboarding packet we can provision the listing and request the Marketplace entitlement.

Next steps (suggested):
1) CloudMart: fill vendor packet + attach signed PO (use attached template)
2) Redwood: confirm whether listing will be direct-bill or marketplace-reseller path
3) If AWS Marketplace path chosen: share listing/reseller ID so Ben can map accounting codes

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf (application/pdf), redwood_po_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships (Vendor Ops)
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-01-09T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: vendor activation + PO workflow for Redwood listing

Jessica — Vanessa here from Marketplace Partnerships. Quick clarifications from our end before we finalize paperwork: 

- For AWS Marketplace SaaS contracts: redemption/invoicing can be handled via AWS (CloudMart as reseller) OR via direct invoicing from Redwood. If you route through AWS, CloudMart will receive a single invoice from AWS; Redwood will reconcile via a monthly settlement. In that case we only need the CloudMart AWS Seller ID and reseller agreement copy.
- For direct invoices, we need a PO referencing Redwood vendor code RDW-0043 (we can provide the PO template Mina attached).
- Payment term flexibility: net30 by default; for strategic listings we can escalate net45 to finance (Ben cc'd).

Lauren — can Legal confirm whether a brief addendum is required for reseller revenue share? If so, I'll prepare the standard Marketplace Reseller Addendum and push it to DocuSign.

Jessica, if you can return the onboarding packet and indicate which billing path you prefer, we'll draft the onboarding timeline. Typical SLA: vendor activation and listing in 7–10 business days after receiving signed packet + PO + SOC 2 evidence.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Partnerships
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Attachments: none
